visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white one-shoulder crop top and black high-waisted leggings, stands on a sunny street. Behind her is a building with a blue sign that reads 'Cafe & Restaurant THE BEACH'. She smiles at the camera with her hands at her sides. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor setting with large floor-to-ceiling glass windows revealing an aerial view of a coastline and urban landscape. The woman is sitting, her hands performing a rhythmic clapping motion. Bright natural light floods the space. (3) Cut back to the outdoor street scene. The woman is now standing and performing synchronized arm movements, looking directly into the lens with a pleasant expression. (4) Scene transitions back to the indoor observation deck. The woman continues her dance routine, highlighting her upper body and hand gestures against the expansive blue sky and sea visible through the glass. (5) Cut to the outdoor location. She continues the dance, swaying her hips slightly while maintaining eye contact. The shadows on the ground indicate a high sun position. (6) Return to the indoor cabin/observation area. She performs a series of precise hand movements, mimicking the rhythm of an unheard track. (7) Back to the street. She smiles broadly while continuing the choreography. The architectural details of the cafe and a green lamppost are visible in the background. (8) Indoor scene again. She completes a segment of the dance, bringing her hands together in a rhythmic pattern. (9) Final cut to the street. She finishes the dance, turns her back to the camera, and walks away towards the cafe building, her long hair swaying.
